section_title: Artist Rights — artists drive their own destiny.
philosophy: AGF aspires to be the catalyst, and driver of, a vibrant and financially healthy arts community. The standard stereo capture and the on-site recording belong to the artist — full stop. The patented version and broadcast-mixed version are co-owned with AGF, **50/50 in perpetuity**, and the artist retains the right to **block any subsequent broadcast by the venue, without cause**. We front-run the inevitable open-source-advocate and big-tech-smear-campaign outrage by being the most artist-favorable contract in the industry.

ownership_tiers.description: Standard stereo, unmixed, raw. **100% owned by the artist.** They can sell it to their heart's content infinitely if they want to perform their own mix/master. AGF takes nothing.
rights: Full ownership of the raw stereo capture
Right to mix, master, and distribute independently
Right to monetize via any channel
No revenue share owed to AGF
restrictions: May not represent the recording as a l'Art / patented version

ownership_tiers.description: The l'Art-encoded version is **owned by AGF** as the inventor. Distribution gated through stereOS-licensed devices and the AGF owners portal.
rights: Performance rights at AGF flagship venues
restrictions: Cannot exist without the artist's standard-stereo capture as input
Subject to artist blocking rights on broadcast

ownership_tiers.description: Broadcast-optimized mix that combines the captured performance with AGF's broadcast-mix engineering. **Revenue split 50/50 in perpetuity.** Artist retains right to block any subsequent broadcast by the venue, without cause.
rights: Right to block any subsequent broadcast (no cause required)
Right to set fan-purchase ("forever copy") pricing
Owner-portal exposure via permanent virtual all-access

enforcement.device_lockout: If AGF can identify a device capturing patented content for illicit distribution, the user — by accepting the terms of service — is **blocked from all future business with AGF**, and legal action will be taken by AGF, on behalf of the artist, to recover proceeds from illicit marketing.
legal_remedies: Recovery of proceeds on behalf of the artist
Permanent ban from AGF hardware ecosystem
Civil action under the terms of service
social_deterrent: Bootlegging positioned as a social faux-pas (not a piracy panic)
Owner status as community-membership signal — withdrawn on violation
Artist communities surface bad actors organically

revenue_streams.description: Artist sells own mix/master via any channel.
AGF distributes through owners portal and stereOS adopters.
Broadcast-optimized stereo+video, distributed through standard app platforms.
AGF hardware owners receive permanent virtual all-access. AGF either provides the venue free or forfeits its share to the venue + artists.
Artist sets pricing. Fan owns digital copy and is responsible for backup.
